title: Do Business Without Intellectual Property: web edition
description:
An unofficial, accessible web edition of Stephan Kinsella’s guide Do Business Without Intellectual Property (Liberty.me Guide 1.0, July 2014), which the author released under CC0.

The author’s text is reproduced verbatim and checked word for word against the original PDF. Editorial additions are marked as such: link-health records with archived copies, sourced “Since 2014” updates, section summaries, term explanations, interactive explainers, a sourced gallery of creators who thrive without IP, and an EPUB edition.

Live site: https://vb6enjoyer.github.io/do-business-without-ip/
notes: Stephan Kinsella is the author of the original 2014 guide; VB6Enjoyer created this web edition and its editorial additions. The original text is CC0; the edition's code and additions are released under the Unlicense.
